request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:FARM

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game map: chunky simple rounded shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, soft slightly desaturated colours, light from the top left, clean edges.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: seen from the front and slightly above, like a garden plot on a strategy game map; drawn on a fully transparent background; nothing is cropped at the top or the bottom.

Class: a repeating field pattern for a square farm tile of a strategy game map: big plump simple shapes standing in straight horizontal rows, each row on its own long narrow strip of ground; a dark outline in a darker tone of each colour (never black), no box, no border and no frame. Everything that is not a row or its strip of ground is empty and transparent.
layers.negative: pedestal, plinth, disc, platform, isometric block, isometric diamond, grass, lawn, background, chequerboard, building, house, barn, fence, people, character, farmer, animal, unit, scarecrow

layers.text: Subject: a small old graveyard: three straight horizontal strips of dark grey-brown earth, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip stands one row of five small dark slate-grey stone gravestones side by side, each a simple upright slab with a pointed top and a tiny carved cross, with a low mound of dark earth in front of it, and a few tiny pale violet flowers; dark slate grey, charcoal and dusty grey-brown only. Gravestones and earth only.
